meta.name: icp-import
meta.description: Translate a client's Notion ICP doc into YALC framework files for a tenant. Reads the Notion page (any structure), maps content flexibly into the 9 canonical YALC sections (framework.yaml, icp/segments.yaml, qualification_rules.md, voice/, positioning/, search_queries.txt, campaign_templates.yaml, company_context.yaml), parks unmappable content in notes.md, and lands everything in _preview/ for review and commit. Use when someone says 'import ICP for X', 'populate framework from Notion', 'sync ICP from Notion for <tenant>', or 'pull ICP into YALC'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Notion 客户画像自动导入 YALC 框架
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Notion 同步客户画像到 YALC 框架
copy.tagline_en: Import Notion ICP into YALC framework automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often sync client profiles from Notion to YALC framework

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能读取客户在 Notion 中的 ICP 文档，自动拆解内容并转换为 YALC 框架所需的 9 个文件（如 framework.yaml、icp/segments.yaml 等），无法归类的内容放入 notes.md，最后将所有文件保存到 _preview/ 文件夹供你审核和提交。
howto.when: 当你说出“导入 X 的 ICP”、“从 Notion 同步 ICP 到 YALC”等包含“导入”、“同步”或“拉取”关键词且提及 ICP 或 Notion 的指令时触发。

say.text: 从 Notion 同步 ICP 到 YALC

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read a client's ICP doc from Notion, automatically parse and map its content into the 9 canonical YALC files (e.g., framework.yaml, icp/segments.yaml), park unmappable content in notes.md, and save everything to _preview/ for your review and commit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "import ICP for X", "populate framework from Notion", "sync ICP from Notion for <tenant>", or "pull ICP into YALC" — any instruction containing "import", "sync", "pull" related to ICP or Notion.

say_en.note: Claude will ask for the Notion URL and tenant slug, then start processing.

say_en.text: Sync ICP from Notion to YALC

say_en.note: Claude will prompt for the Notion link, then generate preview files.
